name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 125 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 117 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist that catches the exact mistakes that get mobile apps rejected from the Apple and Google app stores, before you waste a week waiting on a human reviewer to reject it for you.
buyer: A solo mobile app developer or small agency that has been burned by a surprise App Store rejection right before a launch deadline.
business_use_cases: A mobile dev agency runs every client app through it before submission, selling 'guaranteed-review-ready' as part of their delivery package.
A freelance developer offers a quick paid 'submission audit' service to app teams who built their app elsewhere and just need a pre-flight check.
A compliance-focused startup turns the checklist into a hosted scanning product and sells monthly access to app studios juggling many submissions.

money_ideas.idea: A flat-fee pre-submission audit service for app teams
A hosted compliance-scanning subscription for agencies submitting many apps

steal_this: Offer three indie app developers a free pre-submission check this weekend using the playbook, then turn the ones who got real value into paying customers.
